name: Bumbler
descriptor: AN INCOMPETENT BEEKEEPER AND MEADERY OWNER, HANGING ON BY SHEER LUCK
quote:
"By the Lady, mister Alderman, I didn't mean to knock over the baker's flour! I mean it was just there all of a sudden, and before I knew it we were all covered in white powder. No, that has nothing to do with yesterday's incident. That barrel of rainwater shouldn't have rolled down the hill, I didn't intend for that to happen. I know, I know, the Wise
One is still patching up poor Hyacinth. I've sent her honey to apologize. You know how it is - I'm so sorry. Come by the meadery and we'll drink to better days. That's Good Ol' Bumbler for ya...!"
fellowship_tags: she expects me to grow up

themes.title: WALKING DISASTER
themes.quest: “I guess I am just a big ole bumbler.”
themes.quest_description:
It’s a known fact in the village: if Bumbler
comes your way, better turn around and
mind your step. Everywhere Bumbler goes,
stacks collapse and barrels roll, people trip
and ladders fall. And to spite everyone, she
somehow walks away unscathed. For all her
towering form, wide frame, and clumsy gait,
nothing of the devastation she sows ever seems
to catch up to her.
special_improvements:
Moment to Shine: Once per session,
when you act using tags from this theme, you
may ignore being Imperiled, or treat being
Extremely Imperiled as being Imperiled.

themes.title: BEEKEEPER
themes.quest: “One day, this’ll be the most famous apiary of our dale!”
themes.quest_description:
Sensitive and gentle, Bumblebee Meadows is
an experienced beekeeper, owner of the Golden
Meadows Apiary. She knows how to care for
these yellow-and-tan ambrosia-giving insects,
sensitive to every little change in temperature,
humidity, and light around, and knowing their
hierarchy and power structures (and by proxy,
those of human groups and cliques). She is also
knowledgeable of every flower and plant a bee
can find in the Dales, its flavor and properties.
special_improvements:
Resourceful: When you camp or
sojourn, if you dedicate your time to preparing
or crafting something using your skill, you
may create an extra story tag in addition to the
usual benefits.

themes.title: MEADOWS MEADERY
themes.quest: “This place is where I feel I’m at my best.”
themes.quest_description:
Along with the Golden Meadows Apiary,
Bumbler inherited a meadery, and continues
to practice the brewing of fermented honey
beverages. The spacious shed holds dozens
of barrels along the walls, while at the center
Bumbler hosts her customers on a straw-strewn
packed dirt floor with a few tree stumps for
seats and tables. Locals love to celebrate and
laugh here, as long as everyone survives the
night without bruises.
special_improvements:
Quartermaster: Members of your
Fellowship may treat jugs of frothing mead! as if it
were in their backpack, as long as it is possible
for you to hand it to them and let them use it.

themes.title: VILLAGE FOOL
themes.quest: “If I laugh with them, maybe they’ll forgive everything I’ve broken...”
themes.quest_description:
Sadly, folk around Bumbler mock her
clumsiness at her expense. She doesn’t care
- her bees and meadery are more important
to her than what people say - and so she
reclaimed this status, to make people laugh
or to take liberties others would not for
fear of their reputation. But like with her
mead, she’s feeling some bubbling pressure
fomenting in her, secretly fearing the day
when enough will be enough.
special_improvements:
Expected Role: Once per session,
before you take a social action befitting a village
fool, you may gain amusing-2.
